title.narrative: NATIONAL PROFICIENCY TRAINING WORKSHOP FOR ADMINISTRATORS POLICY MAKERS, TEACHERS AND CAREGIVERS OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES

description.narrative: The Project emphasizes the crucial role of education in societal development, particularly advocating for inclusive education that accommodates children with special needs. It highlights the challenges faced by such children in Nigeria and stresses the importance of teachers being properly equipped to implement inclusive education effectively. The Salamanca Framework for Action is referenced, promoting the idea that all children, regardless of differences, should have access to regular school programs. The article discusses the 2014 educational policy in Nigeria, emphasizing inclusive instruction for children with special needs. However, it points out the persistent challenges and proposes the workshop to address these issues.
